title: Research Dossier Germ Theory
introduction: This dossier examines the historical development of germ theory, focusing on the crucial contributions of Louis Pasteur and Robert Koch that revolutionized our understanding of disease transmission.
mainContent:
# 1. Introduction to miasma theory before germ theory
